about: InstantEvoAndSublimation ("Instant Evo") in a Room Match: every launcher (launcher/room_modes.py) lists every GameModes/<mode>/Mode.json in <game>/ReBalanceOfSouls/gamemodes.txt; the room owner picks one on the Create room dialog's Game Mode row and gamemode.dll arms it for that room (the CharaStatus cells of CharaStatus.json, the flags below). 'rules' is what the Extras page Gamemodes rules shows: [title, text] pairs.
name: Instant Evo
rules: Every character starts the match already Awakened.
The Awakened form's Fighting Spirit gauge fills at its normal rate.
The Reawakened form's Fighting Spirit gauge is 99: it never fills.
rules_fr: Chaque personnage commence le match déjà éveillé.
La jauge de Fighting Spirit en Éveil se remplit à sa vitesse normale.
La jauge de Fighting Spirit en Réveil est à 99 : elle ne se remplit jamais.
